# LipSync

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("LipSync")`

Moves a mouth with what is said (ADR 0200). Parent it to the `MeshPart` that has the face's shape keys and say whose voice it is; while a `Voice` sound plays under that instance, the face's keys follow it. No script moves anything.

**Three ways, each the fallback of the one before.** A line that has a viseme track beside its recording -- `intro_01.visemes.json` beside `intro_01.ogg`, and a language's own beside that language's recording -- plays it: mouth shapes over time, made by a tool. A line with no track is read as it sounds: three frequency bands tell an open mouth from a wide or a round one. And a face with one jaw key opens it by how loud the line is.

**What a viseme, a band and loudness do to THIS face is the model author's**, in a file beside the model as its rig's roles are -- `hero.glb`, `hero.face.json`: a viseme's name to shape keys and weights, which key opens, which widens, which rounds. With no such file, a key named `JawOpen` or `MouthOpen` is opened by loudness.

**It is picture, each machine's own.** A machine plays the track of the language IT hears; nothing of it reaches a tick, a save or another machine. It writes a layer of its own on the shape keys, over what a clip plays and under what a script sets with `SetMorphWeight`.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether it moves the mouth at all. |
| `Map` | `string` | `""` | read/write | The file that says what a viseme, a band and loudness do to this face. Empty is the one beside the mesh's model, with `.face.json` where the model's extension is. |
| `Mode` | `Enum.LipSyncMode` | `Enum.LipSyncMode.Auto` | read/write | Which of the three ways it may use. `Auto` plays a track where the line has one and falls back as described. |
| `Smoothing` | `number` | `0.06` | read/write | The seconds a key takes to get where it is going. 0 snaps; a tenth is a slow mouth. |
| `Source` | `Instance?` | `nil` | read/write | Whose voice it is: a `Voice` sound playing under this instance -- or the instance itself, if it is one -- moves the mouth. A head, a character, a model. Nil is the mesh's own parent. |
| `Weight` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How much of it there is, 0 to 2: 0.5 for a mumble, more than 1 for a shout. |
